projects.name: Autoresearch
projects.what_it_proves: That a discovery pipeline can be built to refuse: honest search under small samples, with claims graded by where the evidence came from.
projects.story: Built inside NeoResist-MD to search for interpretable neoantigen ranking formulas, with a core that is domain-generic. The search itself is standard. The part I care about is the gate: code that decides what the engine is allowed to claim, and stays silent when the evidence cannot support a claim.
evidence: 40,135 ledger rows and 21,848 unique formulas evaluated
0 claims promoted to “validated” by its own gate, which is the intended behaviour, not a failure
a code audit found gate and measurement bugs; they are being fixed before any methods claim is made
work in progress and unpublished

projects.name: Project Genesis
projects.what_it_proves: Independent research design: a simulation built without a fitness function, with null baselines and self-audits applied to its own results.
projects.story: An artificial-life programme asking what emerges when single-cell agents face real death and no fitness function. I treat it as a test of method as much as of the idea: it has already caught and corrected a headline metric that a null control showed to be largely artifact, and a bug that had silently discarded most births.
evidence: fitness-function-free simulation of single-cell agents under existential stakes
powered ablations and null-baseline controls, with 455 automated tests
own earlier results audited and corrected
unpublished; a framework paper is in preparation

projects.name: Reel Logger
projects.what_it_proves: Building and running a working agentic system with sensible safety boundaries, not just prompting one.
projects.story: Share a saved reel to a Telegram bot and it comes back as a structured note in my Obsidian vault with the useful part already extracted.
evidence: Telegram bot → Cloudflare Worker (queue, deduplication) → local processor → Claude → Obsidian note
local processor: video download, frame extraction and speech-to-text, then Claude summarises transcript, caption and frames
safety design: the model gets no file or shell tools, and captions and video are treated as untrusted input
verified end to end in October 2026, including on an Instagram reel
